prompt: In many companies, software and artificial intelligence now carry out routine administrative work that was previously done by employees. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
In the modern world, the companies are using the softwares and artificial intelligence for doing the routine works in the office, which was done by the workers before. This essay will discuss both the advantages and the disadvantages of this development.

On the one hand, there are many advantages of this development. Firstly, the machine can do the work very fast and it does not make the mistakes like human. For example, if a company use a software for the accounting, the calculation will be always correct and the company will save the time. Secondly, it is cheaper for the company, because they do not need to pay the salary for many employees every month. So the company can use this money for other things like marketing.

On the other hand, there are also some disadvantages. Firstly, many people will lose their job because of the machines, and this is a very big problem for the society. Especially the older workers can not learn the new skills easily, so they will be unemployed for the long time. Secondly, the machines sometimes make the errors also, and if nobody in the office understand the system, it will be very difficult to fix the problem.

In conclusion, the automation in the office has both the advantages and the disadvantages. It is good for the company because it is fast and cheap, but it is bad for the workers because they lose the job. Both sides are important, so the companies should think carefully before they use this technology.
title: Automating routine office work
